what: Provenance pin for the vendored copy of the website's shipped map-geometry table.
upstream_commit_subject: feat: map explorer -- per-match and per-map spatial layers with pan/zoom
sha256_is_over: the file's bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, so a clone with core.autocrlf=true cannot fail this pin for a line ending nobody changed
why_vendored: This repo is PUBLIC and searse/keep-the-prac is PRIVATE, so no job here holds a credential that can read the upstream path.
config-tests.yml runs tests/unit/ on every PR with no network and no gh auth, so fetching the table at test time is not available -- not merely slower.
A committed copy is therefore the only way the PR-time gate can compare against the bytes the site ships.
what_this_pin_proves: That the vendored copy still holds the bytes captured from upstream_blob. The test hashes the file and compares it to sha256_lf, so editing the reference to make a comparison pass fails loudly and names the file.
what_this_pin_does_NOT_prove: That upstream still holds these bytes. Nothing reachable from public CI can answer that. If the site's table is hand-edited upstream, this copy goes stale and the suite stays green -- that is the one residual hole, and it is named here rather than papered over.

drift_directions.our config/analytics/spatial_maps/*.json: CAUGHT at PR time -- the derivation no longer reproduces the vendored table and test_the_derivation_reproduces_the_shipped_table fails.
drift_directions.this vendored copy is edited: CAUGHT at PR time -- the sha256 self-check fails before any comparison runs.
drift_directions.a map is dropped from the vendored copy: CAUGHT at PR time -- the non-vacuity assertions pin the map set, so a shrinking fixture fails instead of silently comparing less.
drift_directions.upstream fixture is hand-edited in keep-: NOT CAUGHT. Refresh this pin with the command below; the deployable table in config/analytics/spatial_maps/ stays authoritative over whatever the payload says.

verify_upstream_is_unchanged: The vendored file is byte-identical to upstream_blob, so git's own object id settles both halves with no hashing:
git rev-parse :tests/fixtures/site_map_geometry/map-geometry.json     # this copy -- must equal upstream_blob
git -C <keep-the-prac> rev-parse origin/main:<upstream_path>          # upstream today -- must equal upstream_blob
Run the second from any checkout that can read the private repo. If it differs, upstream moved and this pin is stale: refresh below.
refresh: Run from a checkout that can read the private upstream, e.g. the keep-the-prac clone on the workstation:
Then update every field above in the same commit as the refreshed bytes. A refresh that moves the bytes without moving sha256_lf fails the suite, which is the intended order of operations.

coverage_caveat.dod_anzio: registry.json marks all four review flags true. The equality is meaningful in both directions.
coverage_caveat.dod_thunder2: registry.json leaves all four review flags at their false defaults and records no matches. The equality proves the shipped table matches the generator; it does NOT prove either is right for that map.
coverage_caveat.dod_lennon5_b1: Shipped by the site, but this repo has no spatial_config for it and the generator cannot make one without ktp_flag_positions rows. Deferred by operator ruling 2026-10-08; it is asserted as shipped-but-unconfigured rather than silently skipped.
